sources.title: All incompatible measurements on qubits lead to multiparticle Bell nonlocality
sources.reading: Final author PDF and prior author HTML v3: theorem setting, positive-map proof structure, trine scope, Discussion on known state families and party counts; no reproof of the full positive-map theorem.
sources.used_for: General incompatible-qubit existence is inherited; the explicit GHZ/party-count question remains in the inspected final Discussion.
sources.limit: No claim that no extension anywhere in the literature supplies the planar result.

sources.title: Joint measurability of coplanar POVMs
sources.authors: Taro Yoshino; Koichi Tojo; Kei Hagihara; Akinori Tanaka; Takuki Tomita
sources.reading: Primary indexed abstract only. Direct abstract/HTML/PDF/source did not yield full text.
sources.used_for: Attribution for announced perimeter compatibility criterion.
sources.limit: Bell implications in its full text remain unknown. Our exact symmetric-hull convention is proved independently, not inferred from abstract wording.

sources.title: Measurement Incompatibility versus Bell Nonlocality: An Approach via Tensor Norms
sources.reading: Sections6–8: fixed Alice/optimized Bob setting, compatibility norm, Theorems8.1–8.2, CHSH equality/Remark8.3; relevant definitions and proof passages.
sources.used_for: Credit established norm/parent-based Bell bounds; distinguish the repeated same-family N-party rate from the inspected bipartite framework.
sources.limit: Not an exhaustive reproduction of its 35 pages. No graph/table numerical values used.

sources.title: Symmetric multipartite Bell inequalities via Frank-Wolfe algorithms
sources.reading: Equations6–8 for regular polygon settings and GHZ correlations, SectionsIX.A–B and final scope; targeted main construction comparison.
sources.used_for: Regular-polygon and optimized finite-party GHZ inequalities are inherited.
sources.limit: No superiority to optimized finite-N facets claimed; no numerical plot/table value imported.

sources.title: All multipartite Bell correlation inequalities for two dichotomic observables per site
sources.reading: Two-setting setup and SectionV.D GHZ realization of extremal quantum correlations, nearby equations34–38 and restrictions; SectionV.A inspected for fixed versus variable observable optimization.
sources.used_for: GHZ maximality and equatorial algebra have direct prior constructions; their two-setting optimized-observable setting is not the stated arbitrary fixed planar-family claim.
sources.limit: No independent audit of all inequalities or appendix enumeration.

sources.title: Bell inequalities from multilinear contractions
sources.reading: Introduction and Sections2–3 framing/construction, explicit distinction of Euclidean moment inequalities and supremum-norm ordinary correlation extension.
sources.limit: No claim that its no-bipartite-violation result applies to our ordinary linear Bell expression; no full optimality classification inferred.

sources.title: Avenues to generalising Bell inequalities
sources.authors: Marcin Karczewski; Giovanni Scala; Antonio Mandarino; Ana Belen Sainz; Marek Zukowski
sources.reading: Primary abstract/metadata and construction passages on two-setting origin, complex multioutcome correlations and multiple settings; author v3 dated20July2022.
sources.used_for: Product/complex Bell coefficient constructions are standard ingredients, not our novelty claim.
sources.limit: No exhaustive proof or numerical-example audit. Referenced GitHub code was not accessed.
